comparison.objective: Open a folding-table leg and lock its brace ring before releasing it.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulated mechanism deployment, ring positioning over a knee joint, and load-bearing latch verification.
comparison.success_condition: Leg upright, brace ring beyond the knee, released, and able to withstand a specified folding load.
comparison.reason: PR-1663 tests deployment and locking of a linkage. The candidate tests selective loose-body separation through a screen under controlled agitation; shared release and stability checks are generic primitives only.
